feature.name: recurring tasks
feature.teaser: Set a task to come back every week, month or on the last Friday, and stop copying the same checklist by hand.
feature.headline: Recurring tasks are here
feature.intro: The most-requested feature of the year: tasks that come back on their own. Set it once and the next copy appears when you finish this one.
feature.imageAlt: A task card with a circular arrow showing it repeats every week
points: Every day, week, month, or a pattern like "the last Friday of the month".
Checklists and assignees carry over; comments start fresh.
Skip one occurrence without breaking the series.

alsoImproved: Boards with 500+ tasks open twice as fast.
The morning summary email skips days with nothing due.
